limitations: Validates mechanical consistency and consequences, not empirical learning efficacy.
Displaying the keyboard alone permits 3 stars only at 100% accuracy in a full standard-speed run.
At 100% accuracy, 27/30 minutes in otherwise unassisted standard conditions reaches 3 stars.
Each attack belongs to exactly one shifted window; shared notes never count twice and non-target notes are errors.
The same latent accuracy can land on either side of a star threshold because finite question samples vary.
